img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS. Left: Macro-F1; right: set-level Jaccard. CICC and MULACONF are task-specific conformal baselines trained on annotated calibration data; QP-OneModel is a 10-shot generative baseline. Ours (red) attains the best Macro-F1 on all three benchmarks and the best MixSNIPS Jaccard (0.757), without task-specific training.
